# Starter Dashboard {.unnumbered}

## Goal

Students adapt a minimal dashboard-style knowledge translation product by changing text and interpretation before changing analytic logic.

## Required Elements

- One audience-specific question.
- One interactive or dashboard-style control.
- One visualization.
- One plain-language interpretation.
- One limitation or caution.

## Minimal Review Workflow

1. Run the NHANES dashboard from the repository root.
2. Choose a stakeholder audience, such as a public-health analyst, student team, or community-facing briefing group.
3. Identify one label, caption, help text, or interpretation note that could be clearer for that audience.
4. Make a documentation-only or UI-text-only change.
5. Rerun the dashboard and verify the cached dataset loads.
6. Record the change, audience, and limitation in a short note.

## Student Output

Submit a short dashboard adaptation note containing:

- Audience sentence.
- Before/after text change.
- One screenshot or description of the affected dashboard area.
- Limitation statement.
- Reproducibility note describing how the app was run locally.

## Privacy-Safe Publishing Check

- Do not publish row-level data.
- Avoid small-cell claims.
- State that dashboard outputs are descriptive.
- Keep the cached classroom data separate from raw NHANES retrieval work.
